supported_writer_evidence.invariant: Already APPROVED/REJECTED input cannot have its review metadata rewritten through this official writer; identical status returns existing immutable row.
Selection review is immutable and records canonical_review_status/canonical_reviewed_by/canonical_reviewed_at.
A verifies those private canonical fields against the current canonical row before returning the public result.

current_public_gap: review_provenance exports selected-review author, digest and time, but not the canonical review status/author/time it also verified. B must not read private A options or substitute the selected reviewer for the canonical reviewer.
remaining_threat_scope: A hostile/raw SQL metadata ABA could temporarily repair a corrupt canonical row during the A getter and restore corruption before B locks. No ordinary supported public writer was found that rewrites APPROVED canonical review metadata. This case has not been reproduced or accepted as closed.

requested_additive_fields_under_review_p.name: canonical_reviewed_by
requested_additive_fields_under_review_p.type: exact verified positive integer user ID

required_semantics: Emit only after existing approved/current source validation.
Bind to the same selected canonical submission, selection SHA/revision and immutable selected review SHA.
Keep reviewer_user_id as the actual selected independent reviewer; do not require a historical reviewer login.
Additional fields are source identity evidence, not a new permission grant or epoch.
B can then compare the pinned raw canonical review metadata to these public fields without private A reads.
owner_actions: Root coordinates the additive public export request with Lane A; B has not edited A source or promoted M05/full matrix acceptance.
